description: Predefined asset templates for the Royal Farmers Collective UNS Designer. Each asset is a named bundle of tags with simulation profiles pre-configured. Drop any asset into any node in the UNS tree.

assets.label: Centrifugal Pump
assets.description: Standard centrifugal pump with motor monitoring and flow measurement

assets.label: Control Valve
assets.description: Modulating control valve with position feedback and cycle counting

assets.label: Silo / Buffer Tank
assets.description: Raw material or intermediate product silo with level monitoring and truck intake

assets.label: Boiler / Steam Generator
assets.description: Industrial boiler with steam output, pressure and energy monitoring

assets.label: Packing / Filling Machine
assets.description: High-speed packaging line with full OEE, reject counting and batch traceability

assets.label: IQF Freezer Tunnel
assets.description: Individual Quick Freezing tunnel with temperature, belt speed and energy monitoring

assets.label: Conveyor / Belt Transport
assets.description: Belt or chain conveyor with motor health and throughput monitoring

assets.label: Batch Reactor / Vessel
assets.description: Stirred batch reactor or process vessel with temperature, pressure and quality monitoring

assets.label: Weighbridge / Truck Scale
assets.description: Inbound/outbound weighbridge for truck registration and tonnage tracking

assets.label: Quality Lab Station
assets.description: Inline or at-line quality measurement point with first-pass yield and hold management

assets.label: CMMS / Maintenance Feed
assets.description: Maintenance KPI feed representing CMMS data for a functional location

assets.label: ERP Production Order Feed
assets.description: ERP integration point showing live production order status and financial KPIs

assets.label: Energy / Utility Meter
assets.description: Electrical energy meter with power, cumulative kWh, steam, compressed air and CO₂

assets.label: Production Line (Full Bundle)
assets.description: Complete production line tag set covering OEE, energy, production, maintenance, quality, logistics and finance

assets.label: Fryer / Pre-Fryer
assets.description: Continuous fryer with oil temperature, belt speed and product quality monitoring

assets.label: Drum Dryer
assets.description: Rotating drum dryer for flake or powder production with temperature and moisture control

assets.label: Diffuser / Extractor
assets.description: Continuous counter-current diffuser or extraction tower for juice / extract production

assets.label: Crystallizer / Evaporator
assets.description: Vacuum crystallizer or falling-film evaporator for sugar / concentrate production

assets.label: VFD / Variable Speed Drive
assets.description: Motor VFD control module with a closed speed loop. An optimizer publishes SpeedSetpointRequest (RW command); the controller ramps SpeedSetpoint and the drive PVs (speed, current, power, frequency) follow. Drop on its own drive node.

tags.name: SpeedSetpointRequest
tags.description: SIC — motor speed request (optimizer writes this)

tags.name: ActivePower
tags.description: JI — active power (VFD affinity law ∝ speed³)

assets.label: VFD-Driven Pump (closed loop)
assets.description: Centrifugal pump on a VFD with a full speed control loop. Optimizer → SpeedSetpointRequest; PVs (speed, flow, current, power, frequency) track the committed setpoint. Includes hydraulic + condition-monitoring instruments.

tags.name: SpeedSetpointRequest
tags.description: SIC — pump speed request (optimizer writes this)

assets.label: Decanter Centrifuge (VFD)
assets.description: High-speed solid-bowl decanter on a main-drive VFD. Bowl-speed control loop drives torque, current and power; feed, cake dryness and centrate turbidity are monitored. Energy-intensive — a prime optimizer target.

tags.name: BowlSpeedSetpointRequest
tags.description: SIC — bowl speed request (optimizer writes this)

assets.label: Screw Loader / Feeder (VFD)
assets.description: VFD-driven screw conveyor / feeder with a speed loop that sets mass throughput. Optimizer trims feed rate to balance the line; current, power and mass flow follow the committed setpoint.

tags.name: SpeedSetpointRequest
tags.description: SIC — screw speed request (optimizer writes this)

assets.label: Silo with Level Control
assets.description: Storage silo with a level control loop on the outfeed. Optimizer sets a target level; the controller modulates the outfeed and the level tracks it. Includes weight, hi/lo switches and product-condition instruments.

tags.name: LevelSetpointRequest
tags.description: LIC — target level request (optimizer writes this)

assets.label: Flow Control Loop (FIC + FCV)
assets.description: ISA flow control loop: flow transmitter + controller + control valve. Optimizer sets FlowSetpointRequest; the controller drives the valve and measured flow tracks the committed setpoint. Drop on a control-loop node.

tags.name: FlowSetpointRequest
tags.description: FIC — flow setpoint request (optimizer writes this)

assets.label: Temperature Control Loop (TIC + steam valve)
assets.description: ISA temperature control loop: temperature transmitter + controller + steam control valve. Optimizer sets TempSetpointRequest; measured temperature tracks the committed setpoint while the steam valve modulates.

tags.name: TempSetpointRequest
tags.description: TIC — temperature setpoint request (optimizer writes this)

assets.label: Optical Sorter (sensitivity loop + reject)
assets.description: NIR/laser optical sorter with air-jet ejectors (TOMRA/Key-style). The optimizer tunes detection SENSITIVITY, trading reject rate / yield loss against foreign-material escape. Includes the full realistic PLC-HMI command faceplate: operator mode, accept-optimizer permissive, operator fallback setpoint, EU limits, optimizer heartbeat + watchdog, and a command-status writeback.

tags.name: SensitivitySpRequest
tags.description: AIC — detection sensitivity request (optimizer publishes optimal %)

tags.name: OptimizerHeartbeat
tags.description: Optimizer heartbeat counter — increment every cycle to keep the watchdog alive

tags.name: CommandStatus
tags.description: Writeback: Accepted / Clamped / Local(HMI) / OptimizerDisabled / StaleWatchdog

tags.name: SetpointSource
tags.description: Which setpoint is driving the loop: Optimizer / Operator

tags.name: RejectRate
tags.description: Fraction of stream ejected (rises with sensitivity)

tags.name: ForeignMaterialEscape
tags.description: Foreign material passing to accept (falls with sensitivity)
